messages:
olivia: Heads up — CloudBridge submitted a Marketplace PO and AWS rejected it with an "Entity mismatch" error. Their procurement says the PO must clear before quarter close.

sanjay: Do we have the PO# and error details?

olivia: PO# CB-2026-4485. AWS error: MP_ENTITY_MISMATCH. Console shows our seller record as 'Redwood Inference US LLC' but buyer's PO is for 'CloudBridge EU Ltd'. Screenshot uploaded to S3: https://s3.amazonaws.com/r-infra/tmp/cb-po-err.png

maria: Adding finance. This sounds like a billing entity alias problem on the Marketplace side. We can add an alias for the EU entity, but AWS onboarding usually takes 24–48h unless we escalate.

kevin_aws: @olivia from AWS Marketplace support — we can add an alternate billing alias, but we need a signed Letter of Authorization (LOA) from Redwood and the buyer's VAT/Tax ID for verification.

olivia: I can get LOA signed today. Buyer provided VAT GB123456789. I'll upload both.

amy_deals: Legal, any concerns with accepting the PO offline while alias propagates? We might have to issue an offline invoice and reconcile later.

legal_bot: (bot) Template available: "Marketplace PO Acceptance Addendum v1". Requires seller rep signature and buyer KYC. Typical turnaround: 4–6 business hours after signatures.

finance_ops: If we accept offline, finance needs a suspense account to track tax reconciliation — AWS handles tax differently than offline invoices. Please don't finalize revenue recognition until AWS reconciliation completes.

sanjay: Also recommend setting the customer's subscription state to "on hold" so they don't autoscale & consume units before billing is reconciled.

olivia: On it — setting subscription to hold now. @kevin_aws can you confirm ETA for alias once LOA is uploaded and VAT confirmed?

kevin_aws: ETA 18–24h after LOA + VAT verification. If you mark case as urgent and provide buyer KYC docs it can be same-day.

olivia: Uploading LOA + VAT docs to AWS case now (case created). Buyer also signed the addendum and returned it — attaching.

maria: Finance will prepare a suspense ledger entry and standby for offline invoice if needed. Ping me with invoice number.

sanjay: Contingency plan: if alias can't be added, worst case we refund the offline purchase and ask buyer to repurchase under matching billing entity. Not ideal but workable.

amy_deals: Agreed — try LOA path first. That keeps the customer's procurement intact.

olivia: LOA uploaded to AWS support case 678901. Marking as high priority. :exclamation:

kevin_aws: Received docs, escalated to Marketplace onboarding. I'll post the onboarding case ID and ETA once they reply. :thumbsup:

olivia: UPDATE: AWS confirmed alias added ~22h after LOA, PO accepted by Marketplace. Buyer completed procurement and subscription activated. Closing loop — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

maria: Confirmed: finance reconciled the offline invoice into AWS billing, suspense account cleared. All good.

sanjay: Nice — note for playbook: require buyer VAT/KYC and LOA to be ready when marketplace PO entity mismatch occurs. Saves time on escalation.

amy_deals: Adding that checklist to Marketplace deal playbook now.

olivia: Closing thread.
